narrative.overview: Neutral Zinc light/dark surfaces, Servitech green-led actions and interactive links, warm gold focus/warning accents, institutional crimson destructive actions (a 4-role institutional palette with zero blue shades), Inter typography and restrained tactile controls form the shared visual identity.
keyCharacteristics: 4-role institutional palette with zero blue shades: pure neutral Zinc layers, Servitech green primary/links/selection, warm gold focus/warnings, and institutional crimson destructive states.
Clear hierarchy and task-oriented language across public, Applicant, Student, Faculty, and Staff experiences.
Forms collect only facts the task actually needs, without generic paperwork boxes lacking an SIA source-document purpose.
Formal, version-bound, monochrome-capable official outputs with Servitech Institute Asia Inc. as issuer.

rules.name: The 4-Role Zero-Blue Palette Rule
rules.body: TALA uses pure neutral Zinc layers (Filament gray and info mapped to Color::Zinc), Servitech green for primary actions, interactive links, and selection tints, warm gold/amber for keyboard focus rings and warning states, and institutional crimson for destructive actions — zero blue shades.

rules.name: The Control Meaning Rule
rules.body: Green identifies the current primary task; achieved success remains a status, neutral controls support navigation and routine secondary work, warning marks consequential interruption, and danger marks withdrawal, discard, or destructive cancellation. Cancellation color follows its effect across every workspace.

rules.name: The Minimal Form Evidence Rule
rules.body: Forms collect facts the task actually needs. Derive the authenticated actor, recorded time, and known record context; omit generic Approving authority or Evidence reference boxes unless an SIA source-document purpose requires them.

rules.name: The Shared Elevation Ladder Rule
rules.body: Canvas -> neutral chrome -> solid task surface -> raised detail surface -> opaque floating overlay. Dark appearance uses explicit Zinc lightness separation (#151619 / #1e2024 / #27282c / #303237 / #35373d) with sunken troughs (#1b1c20) and restrained rims.

dos: Lead visible school services and official documents with Servitech Institute Asia Inc.; omit Powered by TALA from all authenticated pages.
Preserve native Light/Dark/System behavior, WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, visible warm-gold keyboard focus, and meaning beyond color alone.
Reuse shared semantic tokens, tactile Aqua-like action depth, and zero-overflow responsive tables across Filament and Bootstrap surfaces.
Collect only necessary task facts in forms and provide truthful, actionable error diagnostics and recovery controls.
donts: Do not introduce blue shades into neutral, info, link, or accent UI tokens.
Do not rely on generic paperwork fields, unactionable placeholder boxes, or native <details> accordions for operational evidence.
Do not allow unbroken user strings or multi-button rows to clip table actions behind horizontal scrollbars.
